admission.justification: Shared path selection, current base projections, formatter bounds, counted onboarding updates and pair carry-over together prevent a legal card from losing visibility at a later memory operation.

guarantee: An eligible file card under a dot directory in a converted memory root stays visible from discovery and validation through indexed reads, formatting, and counted onboarding updates, and a selected Markdown and sidecar pair can pass through carry-over under the same admission rules as other pairs.
title: Eligible cards under dot directories stay visible
